orders.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS count,min(o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date::text AS first,max(o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date::text AS last FROM business.orders o  WHERE o.dataset_version=$1 AND o.store_id=$2

order_items.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS count,min(p.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date::text AS first,max(p.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date::text AS last FROM business.order_items o JOIN business.orders p USING(dataset_version,store_id,order_id) WHERE o.dataset_version=$1 AND o.store_id=$2

refund_events.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS count,min(o.succeeded_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date::text AS first,max(o.succeeded_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date::text AS last FROM business.refund_events o  WHERE o.dataset_version=$1 AND o.store_id=$2

inventory.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS count,min(o.hour_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date::text AS first,max(o.hour_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date::text AS last FROM business.inventory_hourly o  WHERE o.dataset_version=$1 AND o.store_id=$2

traffic.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS count,min(o.business_date)::date::text AS first,max(o.business_date)::date::text AS last FROM business.traffic_daily o  WHERE o.dataset_version=$1 AND o.store_id=$2

promotion.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS count,min(o.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date::text AS first,max(o.end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date::text AS last FROM business.promotion_events o  WHERE o.dataset_version=$1 AND o.store_id=$2

results.note: 总订单4与支付成功订单3不同；前端将成功订单字段显示为后端尚未提供。
